Prix Goncourt Removes Novel Amid AI Authorship Claims

The organizers of France's Prix Goncourt literary prize removed Canadian-Haitian novelist Thélyson Orélien's book, "It Was Either That or Die," from its longlist on Friday. This decision followed online claims that the novel was largely written by artificial intelligence (AI).
